## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: majority of sectors are positive this week but key groups (Financials, Industrials, Real Estate) remain negative, and leadership is split across Materials/Healthcare/Technology — Leadership: Moderate (Top 5 span 3 sectors); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND.  
Energy strong: SLB (1W: +6.36% | 1M: +30.10%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +12.91%) ABOVE TREND.  
Healthcare constructive: GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Real Estate weak: PLD (1W: -5.09% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, PSA (1W: -5.15% | 1M: +7.45%) CORRECTION.  
Industrials soft: GE (1W: -9.25% | 1M: -6.38%) BELOW TREND, MMM (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -0.39%) BELOW TREND.  
Financials fragile: JPM (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.93% | 1M: -11.07%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +16.94%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate (Top 5 span Materials/Healthcare/Tech); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TJX (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -3.75%) BELOW TREND, MMM (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -0.39%) BELOW TREND, PLD (1W: -5.09% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, PSA (1W: -5.15% | 1M: +7.45%) CORRECTION, TGT (1W: -6.58% | 1M: +10.24%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Real Estate/Consumer names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +16.94%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +7.09% | 1M: -11.67%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR divergence as several large caps (MSFT, NVDA, NOW, V, LLY) show 1W/1M mismatches; watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed: META (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +16.94%) ABOVE TREND offset by AVGO (1W: -7.64% | 1M: -7.01%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -6.22%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -1.45%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +2.27% | 1M: -3.40%) RECOVERY — Sector breadth: mixed (19 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Weak: JPM (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.93% | 1M: -11.07%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -8.36%) BELOW TREND while V (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -7.04%) RECOVERY — sector 1W negative and breadth tilted lower (20 stocks).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Constructive: GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND, but ABT (1W: -10.67% | 1M: -12.22%) BELOW TREND — sector is a relative safe harbor this week (15 stocks positive overall).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Materials/Energy/Healthcare exposure (NEM, SLB, UNH) and monitor Technology names with mixed internals; reduce exposure to lagging Financials and select Real Estate names showing clear weakness. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given the multiple recoveries and corrections among large caps.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: COF (1W: -7.93% | 1M: -11.07%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, ABT (1W: -10.67% | 1M: -12.22%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (NEM-led), Energy (SLB/XOM) and Healthcare given positive internals (Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive).  
BEARISH: Financials, Real Estate and Industrials where 1W performance is lagging and select names show growing downside risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch META continuation above recent 1W highs to confirm ABOVE TREND follow-through; monitor NEM for sustainment above its 1M rally to validate Materials leadership; if JPM fails near recent 1M highs, expect Financials downside to persist; NOW needs follow-through from RECOVERY (1W gain with 1M negative) to confirm trend change.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NEM (+55): Gold-rally headlines; NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.  
JNJ (+55): Upgrade/guide lift; JNJ (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming accumulation.  
BA (+55): Upbeat Q4; BA (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND — news aligns with strong 1M performance.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
UNH (-65): Medicare-related headline; UNH (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND — negative news diverging from price (distribution risk).  
CVS (-50): Medicare-rate worries; CVS (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from strong price action.  
WMT (-50): Storm disruption headlines; WMT (1W: -1.72% | 1M: +6.08%) CORRECTION — news aligns with near-term softness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences in large caps (MSFT, NVDA, NOW) and several bearish headlines (UNH, CVS) that diverge from price — watch for trend confirmation.
